# Support

## Getting Help

### Documentation

- **[AME Wizard Documentation](https://docs.amelabs.net)** — Official documentation for AME Wizard actions, playbook creation, and ISO injection
- **[README](../README.md)** — Project overview, features, installation, and FAQ

### Community

- **GitHub Discussions**: Use [Discussions](https://github.com/alimoradmohameddoweb/valex-os-playbook/discussions) for questions, ideas, and general help
- **Issues**: Use [Issues](https://github.com/alimoradmohameddoweb/valex-os-playbook/issues) for bug reports and feature requests (guided by our templates)

### Commercial Support

For commercial support or custom playbook development, please reach out via the repository's [Discussions](https://github.com/alimoradmohameddoweb/valex-os-playbook/discussions) page.

## Before Opening an Issue

Please check:

1. The [FAQ](../README.md#faq) in the README
2. Existing [open and closed issues](https://github.com/alimoradmohameddoweb/valex-os-playbook/issues?q=is%3Aissue)
3. The [AME Wizard documentation](https://docs.amelabs.net)

If you still need help, use the appropriate issue template or start a Discussion.
